zones.method: Per season: 90th-percentile EVI per 30 m pixel (≥3 clear images), divided by the median of the field's interior pixels that season; averaged over seasons (≥2). Weaker < 0.95, stronger > 1.05 of the field median. Consistency = share of seasons on the same side of the median. Edge pixels overlap neighbouring land and are not classified. Uncalibrated: satellite greenness, not measured yield.
